records.name: Burning Swan
records.source_quest_or_shop: PQ 167; research corpus reports 45% on any clear
records.skill_description: Fire a slow-moving Ki Blast; charging increases projectile speed and hit count, and Boost Dash or Step can be performed immediately after firing.
records.mechanics_notes: Charge improves both speed and hit count. The immediate dash/step option allows the user to move behind or alongside the projectile as pressure or cover.
records.combo_notes: Can be used as a projectile screen before a Boost Dash or Step; charge level changes timing and hit count.
records.pve_notes: Useful for controlling space and approaching groups while the projectile travels slowly.
records.pvp_notes: The post-fire movement option creates a layered approach, but the slow projectile and charge commitment require matchup-aware timing.

records.name: Burning Spin
records.unlock_method: Shenron wish "I want a new Ultimate Attack!" on the second time the wish is made
records.source_quest_or_shop: Shenron fixed reward sequence; second use of the Ultimate Attack wish
records.skill_description: Wrap yourself in flames and move freely while attacking using the movement stick.
records.mechanics_notes: Creates a steerable flame sphere for roughly eight seconds. Research corpus reports approximately 5% damage per flame contact, with total damage depending on how many times the target is contacted.
records.combo_notes: Most effective when the target is constrained or downed enough to permit repeated flame contacts; open movement can escape the stance.
records.pve_notes: Steerable area contact can pressure groups and stationary targets; effectiveness depends heavily on positioning and contact count.
records.pvp_notes: Requires prediction and positioning because opponents can disengage from the steerable stance.

records.name: Burning Strike
records.source_quest_or_shop: TP Medal Shop; research corpus reports 250 TP Medals while stocked
records.skill_description: Teleport in front of the opponent for a devastating kick, or press down on the stick during the move to teleport behind instead.
records.mechanics_notes: The defining property is selectable front/behind teleport positioning. The research corpus does not provide a published exact damage value.
records.combo_notes: Useful after a confirm that leaves the target vulnerable; the front/behind option can alter the approach angle.
records.pve_notes: Teleport delivery provides direct access to targets, while the single-hit nature makes a miss costly.
records.pvp_notes: The front/behind input creates a positioning mix-up against opponents defending the initial approach.
